# `proof/` — Auto-Generated Pipeline Artifacts

This folder holds **machine-generated** proof artifacts produced by the AutoSOC pipeline and verification scripts. Files here are rewritten on each pipeline run.

**Not the same as [`PROOF_PACK/`](../PROOF_PACK/).** Use this table to decide which one you want:

| If you want... | Open | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Curated reviewer-facing proof (verified counts, architecture, samples, screenshots) | [`PROOF_PACK/`](../PROOF_PACK/) | Source of truth for all public numbers |
| Live pipeline output (latest metrics, validation checks, quality scorecards) | `proof/` (this folder) | Regenerated by CI on every push |

## Contents

| Path | Produced by | Consumed by |
|---|---|---|
| `autosoc/latest/` | `scripts/auto-soc/` pipeline + `scripts/publish/promote-autosoc.ps1` | `scripts/generate-metrics.js` |
| `validation/latest.{json,md}` | `scripts/generate-proof-lanes.js` | `site/proof/` mirror |
| `quality/latest.{json,md}` | `scripts/generate-proof-lanes.js` | `site/proof/` mirror |
| `grafana/latest.*` | Pipeline (Grafana dashboard capture) | `site/proof/` mirror |
| `wazuh/honeypot/` | Wazuh honeypot capture | `site/proof/` mirror |

## Data flow

```
scripts/auto-soc/ pipeline  -->  proof/autosoc/latest/
scripts/generate-proof-lanes.js  -->  proof/validation/, proof/quality/
                                   -->  site/proof/ (mirrored)
```

## Do not edit files in this folder by hand

Everything here is regenerated by scripts. Hand edits will be overwritten on the next pipeline run. If a value here is wrong, fix the upstream script or the canonical benchmark in `PROOF_PACK/`, not the file in `proof/`.

## Related

- [`PROOF_PACK/VERIFIED_COUNTS.md`](../PROOF_PACK/VERIFIED_COUNTS.md) — the source of truth for all public numbers
- [`PROOF_PACK/TRUTH_MANIFEST.md`](../PROOF_PACK/TRUTH_MANIFEST.md) — full provenance for every published metric
- [`scripts/generate-proof-lanes.js`](../scripts/generate-proof-lanes.js) — generator for `proof/validation/` and `proof/quality/`
- [`scripts/generate-metrics.js`](../scripts/generate-metrics.js) — aggregator that reads `proof/autosoc/latest/`
